description: You're just really, really sleepy. You have a fatigue bar, and it drains every second you're not in a rested area. If it hits 0, you fall asleep and never wake up.
name: Narcolepsy

rules.description: You are fatigued if not in a rested area.
rules.name: Fatigued Unless Resting

rules.description: You cannot queue for or participate in Dungeons.
rules.name: No Dungeons
